sources.title: GPUDirect RDMA overview
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Lustre OST 條帶：平行頻寬與客戶端上限
related.titleEn: Lustre OST striping: parallel bandwidth and client ceilings
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：每個效能結論可回溯至其模型；資料正確性獨立驗收。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Each performance claim traces to its model and data correctness is accepted independently.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Lustre OST 條帶：平行頻寬與客戶端上限」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付檔案區段圖、OST 分攤表與端點瓶頸圖。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Lustre OST striping: parallel bandwidth and client ceilings with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver file extents, OST allocation tables and endpoint bottleneck diagrams.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以 8 GB 依序通過 32 與 25 GB/s 算時間，寫出採用十進位 GB。
先算 OST 合計 6 GB/s，再和 12 GB/s client 比較；從慢的一側推時間。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Move 8 GB sequentially through 32 and 25 GB/s links, explicitly using decimal GB.
Compare aggregate OST bandwidth of 6 GB/s with a 12 GB/s client and use the slower side.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Darshan I/O 證據：小寫入分佈與平均值陷阱
related.titleEn: Darshan I/O evidence: small-write distributions and mean-value traps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：每個效能結論可回溯至其模型；資料正確性獨立驗收。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Each performance claim traces to its model and data correctness is accepted independently.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Darshan I/O 證據：小寫入分佈與平均值陷阱」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付 rank×操作數表、粒度直方圖、聚合前後 checksum 與假說清單。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Darshan I/O evidence: small-write distributions and mean-value traps with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver rank/operation tables, size histograms, before/after checksums and hypotheses.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以 8 GB 依序通過 32 與 25 GB/s 算時間，寫出採用十進位 GB。
用 64 MiB 和 16384 次計算，再以 4 KiB×16384 反向核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Move 8 GB sequentially through 32 and 25 GB/s links, explicitly using decimal GB.
Calculate from 64 MiB and 16384 calls, then reverse-check with 4 KiB×16384.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
